justification: `javaparser-symbol-solver-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/symbolsolver/declarations/common/MethodDeclarationCommonLogic.java` is the only class in the package. It imports only core resolution abstractions and JDK types (`com.github.javaparser.resolution.*`, `InferenceContext`, `java.util.*`) and is directly reused by exactly three production classes: `JavassistMethodDeclaration`, `ReflectionMethodDeclaration`, and `JavaParserMethodDeclaration` in the same module. I found no evidence that this package depends on a less stable package than itself.
